_meta.what_this_is: A recall ledger for six curriculum modules at a fixed clock (now = day 200). Each module has an authoring status and a list of dated closed-book recall passes (as day numbers). 'authored' is the teacher's checkmark (status ready); 'retained' is the learner's, computed as a recall pass within the 60-day retention window. The fixture is built so authoring overcounts retention: one module was never recall-tested, one passed only long ago (decayed), and one is still a draft.
_meta.ledger_is: A FIXTURE. Day numbers stand in for dates so the module is deterministic. Point it at your own recall ledger with real dates.
_meta.retention: a pass older than 60 days no longer counts as retained
_meta.format: now (day int); modules [{id, status, passes:[day ints]}]
